searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/pull/51 https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-APIs/issues/50 maybe we should discuss this suggestion before the api goes too far down the track - basically a tweak to the duties endpoints Making public keys optional for the attester endpoint could be an option but not sure if that would be considered too expensive a call to be the default. i was thinking potentially just adding optional pubkeys on the proposer and making it a post instead of get (because of potential number of keys to submit) im keen on not having the attester duties get out of control ideally Given that we have 32 proposers per epoch a filter seems overkill yep, so it'd only be to offload the processing, and just get a list of proposers you're actually interested in, from a client perspective so as a client you get back an empty list from your api call, you know you're not proposing anything this epoch thats the only use case i can think of, just for doing less on the client after the fact There are two use cases I see: get everything, and get just what I'm interested in. The latter would surely be quicker with client-side filtering than shipping over the list of validators, especially if you have more than a few validators to check. seems like a slim use case to justify changing a GET to a POST and having an optional param processing i guess heh
